title: Lean of the Mathematical Commons: Emmy Noether pilot
description:
A living, source-linked Lean 4 library and Mathlib coverage audit for classical mathematics, beginning with Emmy Noether. This release includes the pinned Lean/Mathlib project, promoted theorem modules, paper- and theorem-level coverage ledgers, controlled-witness provenance, bounded-memory build tooling, axiom audits, build receipts, limitations, and publication evidence.

Version 0.2.5 adds two coherent P22 clusters. FirstSmithGroundReciprocity types Hentzelt--Noether's module-valued ideal quotient separately from the scalar-colon ideal and proves both reciprocal Satz-II formulas for the actual localized cutoff-one Smith pair under the explicit greatest-coefficient divisibility hypothesis. FirstSmithAnnihilatorBounds formalizes the opening finite algebra of Satz VIII without an ordering hypothesis: the quotient annihilator is the intersection of the selected principal coefficient ideals, the selected coefficient-product ideal lies below it, its rank-th power lies below the product ideal, the corresponding principal generators satisfy both divisibilities, and the radicals agree. The release adds 24 declarations and brings P22 to 511 declarations across the base and 29 support modules.

The selected product is not identified with Hentzelt's primitive resultant form, and the intrinsic annihilator generator is not identified with a normalized historical elementary-divisor form. Canonical divisibility ordering, normalization, choice independence, determinant-norm/resultant identification, primitive descent, historical unbounded-tail identification, later elimination stages, equations (33)--(34), compatible zeros, and multiplicity conclusions remain open. Lean verification certifies only formal statements and explicit assumptions; it does not certify German transcription fidelity, translation, prose, layout, completeness, or critical-edition status. German canon authority remains separate from this repository.
